description:
From the fz-kdt.183 research (2026-09-03). Two facts. (1) Types::convergence_
class_at (types/mod.rs:792-796) turns a pure callable slot of a recursive key
into address_var(path): List.reduce_step/3 keys its reducer as a2 while
reduce_cont/3's body CALLS it, so the return depends on a slot the key erased
(the same invariant fz-kdt.183 states for the list element). Candidate A
(keep the callable verbatim) measured 7 behaviour movers that are ONE failure
seven times: "backend dispatch call requires semantic argument N value N:
backend value N is unbound" on 00231, 00281, 00285, enum_map_family,
enum_reduce_halt_arm_order, opaque_fn_value_join, range_enumerable -- the
multi-target-closure arg-floor family pinned at drive_test.rs:16351-16394
(a reducer that is a runtime union of targets, 00281's `case -> add_a | add_b`,
specialized per target stops being materialized: param_reprs [ValueRef,
RawInt, RawInt] -> [RawInt, RawInt], carrier ValueRef -> Absent). So the
callable half is blocked behind RUNTIME DEMAND, not semantics; that pin says
the family was fixed -- it recurs the moment a key names a union of targets.
(2) On the NON-recursive branch, erase_closure_identity (types/mod.rs:2926)
recurses into captures (:2941), so on 00420 Enum.reduce_while/3 (mask all
Ignore) collapses seven distinct lambdas (#79/#81/#82/#89/#83/#85/#86) into
one key `(a2_p0, a2_p1) -> a2_r#?closure[(a1_p0) -> a1_r]` -- seven
publishers, one return. After fz-kdt.183's element fix 78 blind-shared
activations remain, 32 of them Enum.reduce_while/3. Related: consumes_
callable_identity is computed from ONE body (jobs/keying.rs::body_consumes_
callable_identity); a forwarder that hands its reducer to a body that calls
it consumes identity transitively (the StaticCallees walk derive_call_graph_
component already does) -- measure that first, it may retire most of (2)
without touching the arg-floor. Sequence after fz-kdt.183.
title: The callable slot of a recursive activation key stays blind (a2): naming the reducer is blocked behind the multi-target-closure arg-floor, and Enum.reduce_while/3 collapses seven lambdas into one key
